newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco designs polyester car for rural rides.
newsitem.headline: Morocco designs polyester car for rural rides.

text.p: Morocco plans to recycle old vehicles in a new polyester body for use in the country's remote rural areas, the official MAP news agency said on Wednesday.
"The car is the result of recycling old vehicles, which makes it cost less than other vehicles," MAP quoted the state-run Office National de la Formation professionnelle as saying.
The new vehicle, which has a French-made Renault 4 engine, will be manufactured on a large scale after the government lowers taxes on imports of spare parts.
According to a market analyst, the new car is expected to be sold on the domestic market at around $7,000 per unit.
Morocco earlier launched an economic car made by Italy's Fiat firm worth $7,500, the analyst said.
